Here's what's new:[/p][p][/p][p]🔥 Reworked weapon mechanics – smoother, deadlier, more fun  [/p][p]🎯 Visual and graphic improvements – hell has never looked this good  [/p][p]ːwinter2019coolyulː New traps – because dodging fireballs wasn’t enough [/p][p]🌀 Improved level transitions – more fluid, more immersive  [/p][p]🧠 UI/UX overhaul – easier to navigate, better to play [/p][p]🌎 Additional stages - more room for fighting[/p][p][/p][p]Meanwhile, we're working hard behind the scenes to bring you the full version of [b]Hell Games[/b]. notes.title: Update February 2025
notes.content:
Fiery updates you can expect from the newest version of the Hell Games demo:

[list]

Happy Gaming!

notes.title: Get ready for HELL GAMES
notes.content:
Welcome to Hell! Where it’s unfair, hot and fun! The demo of our arena brawler 🔥HELL GAMES🔥 is now live on Steam. 

We’re incredibly excited to finally share this milestone with the world and hope you’ll knock each other out in the game. Of course, we’re working hard in the background on new builds and updates.
Have fun, and feel free to let us know what you think of Hell Games on Discord, X, or TikTok!

notes.title: Hell Games meets LevelUp
notes.content:
Ready, set, brawl!

Who’s up for a good beat-up in the depths of hell? At LevelUp in Salzburg, you can face off against us or each other in the 🔥HELL GAMES🔥. We'll be at the Messezentrum Salzburg in the Indie Games Area on June 29th and 30th, and we’re looking forward to seeing you there!

In the 🔥HELL GAMES🔥, fallen Olympians, once cheaters and dopers, battle it out in the depths of hell. Use sports equipment to take out your opponents, grab power-ups, and eliminate your foes. This brawling fun is designed for up to 4 players and appeals to both newcomers and gaming veterans.

Come by, brawl, and have fun!
